audit.whatIsWrong: diff said TRICKY with diffRating 7/10 and an orange tone, against a 59.17% Emerald+ win rate over 992 games.
audit.why: 59.17% over a 992-game sample is one of Dr. Mundo's better matchups, and the page's own content agrees - spikes[3] literally cites 'your strong 59% win rate' and content.late calls it 'a comfortable 59% for you'. TRICKY / 7-10 was the only part that disagreed, and it drove the tone colour and both difficulty lines too.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY -> EVEN, diffRating 7/10 -> 3/10, tone -> the green used elsewhere for favourable lanes, and breakdown.difficulty / report[14].t rewritten to 'Favoured matchup - difficulty 3/10'. carryRating left at 7.5/10: Kennen is still a real teamfight threat even when he loses lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is wrong in five of seven stages, in both layers. content.win[2..6] and full.phases[2..6].side say Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Skill / Skill, while content.whys[2..6] say 'Q Infected Bonesaw out-sustains his poke', 'your regen beats his poke', 'R Maximum Dosage tanks his full Slicing Maelstrom', 'a wall his magic poke can't chunk' and 'you're unkillable'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is [Kennen, Kennen, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo] - he owns the first two levels on shuriken range and nothing after that. Every prose field already describes exactly that shape; only the side tokens lagged. A 59.17% win rate cannot come from a chart where Mundo never wins a stage.
audit.corrected: Whole-chart flip as one group: content win[2..6] -> Dr. Mundo; full phases[2].side/[3].side Kennen -> Dr. Mundo (3/10 -> 7/10 each), phases[4]/[5]/[6].side Skill -> Dr. Mundo (6/10 -> 7/10, 6/10 -> 8/10, 5/10 -> 8/10). phases[2], [3], [4] and [5] whys rewritten with real numbers; phases[6].why already read as a Mundo win and was left alone. Also fixed report[2].t and breakdown.spikes, which listed levels 3 and 4-5 as Kennen's windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining interaction was never stated: Mark of the Storm stuns on the third mark, and Goes Where He Pleases resists the FIRST Immobilizing effect that hits Dr. Mundo. Kennen's entire kill pattern is the triple-mark stun, and Mundo's passive cancels the first one outright and hands him a healing canister for it. Nothing on the page said so. Separately, three fields (spikes[2].text, whys[5], content.late, wants.you[2]) tell you to buy Grievous Wounds against Kennen, who has no healing in his kit at all.
audit.why: Riot on Kennen's passive: 'Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.' Riot on Mundo's passive: 'Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby... restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown.' A stun is an Immobilizing effect, so the first triple-mark payoff of the lane is free and refunds health. And Grievous Wounds does nothing to a champion with no heal - the stat that actually matters is Magic Resist, because Electrical Surge applies on-hit magic damage every few attacks.
audit.corrected: Wrote the passive-eats-the-stun interaction into tldr, report[0].t, report[5].t, tradeGood, phases[2].why, dosFull[1] and report[9].t. Replaced every 'grievous' reference with MR / Spirit Visage / Mercury's Treads in spikes[2].text, whys[5], content.late and wants.you[2], and rewrote report[8].t to say why armour is the wrong buy here.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown line named Lightning Rush as '(10s)' and nothing else, and none of them mentioned energy - which is the resource that actually gates Kennen.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken is 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s at 60 energy falling to 40, Electrical Surge is 13s down to 6s at 40 energy, and Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s at 80 energy. Landing three marks therefore costs him 180 energy at rank 1 out of a 200 pool - one full combo empties him, and an empty Kennen has no escape and no poke. That is the punishable window, and it is far more frequent than any single cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with all four real numbers plus the energy costs, and re-keyed dosFull[0], dosFull[2], phases[3].why, breakdown.mid, content.mid and report[9].t to 'commit when his energy bar is empty'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields carry PDF extraction garbage that ships to the page: tradeGood, breakdown.trading and report[3].t all end with '• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 67'. Also, nothing anywhere said Thundering Shuriken is a skillshot that stops on the first thing it hits.
audit.why: The bullet-and-page-number string is a footer from whatever document this text was scraped from; it is not advice and does not belong on a live page. And Riot's Q text - 'throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits' - at 950 range means a single minion standing between you and Kennen denies him both the poke and the mark, which is the whole early game.
audit.corrected: Removed the footer string from all three fields as part of rewriting them, and wrote the minion-block into tradeGood, loading, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, dontsFull[1].d and content.early.

notes: PDF FOOTER SHIPPING TO THE PAGE: tradeGood, breakdown.trading and report[3].t all contained the literal string '• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 67'. Worth grepping the whole champ-data set for 'Matchup Database' - if it leaked into three fields on one matchup it is very unlikely to be confined to Kennen. GRIEVOUS WOUNDS vs KENNEN: four fields told the reader to buy anti-heal against a champion whose kit contains no healing; all four are corrected to MR. ENUM UNCERTAINTY: I set diff to 'EVEN' because that token is verified to exist in this dataset (Kassadin's entry uses it).
